relationships.subject: GRK2/3
relationships.evidence_quote: the effects of exogenous cannabinoids are significantly reduced because of CB1R desensitization via GRK2/3, as function is recovered in the presence of the GRK2/3 inhibitor, Compound 101 (Cmp101)

relationships.subject: JZL184
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibiting 2-AG degradation with the monoacylglycerol lipase (MAGL) inhibitor JZL184 during inflammation results in the desensitization of CB1Rs by endocannabinoids that is reversed with Cmp101

relationships.subject: MAGL
relationships.evidence_quote: MAGL degradation of 2-AG protects CB1Rs from desensitization in inflamed rats

relationships.subject: persistent inflammation
relationships.evidence_quote: 2-AG tone is detected in slices from CFA-treated rats when GRK2/3 is blocked, suggesting an increase in 2-AG synthesis after persistent inflammation

key_findings: Persistent inflammation primes presynaptic CB1Rs in vlPAG for GRK2/3-dependent desensitization, while mu-opioid receptors do not desensitize.
MAGL degradation of 2-AG protects CB1Rs from desensitization by endocannabinoids after inflammation.
